issues.on_page: Exhibit H Inheritance Tax fund schedule prints 'Local' 49,716; Exhibit D (p4) Inheritance Tax column prints it on the 'Inheritance Tax' row
issues.issue: The amount is right. The schedule line was relabelled from Exhibit D and marked split_from, but it is a one-to-one relabel, not a split. The 2026-11-06 ruling keeps Inheritance Tax Fund receipts printed as 'Local...' as printed. Here, though, Exhibit D does print the Inheritance Tax label for this exact cell, so this is defensible.
